$comment: SAFETY FLOOR for this project. Copied into every new project.
Changed 19-08-2026. Previously this file carried an `ask` list. Ask rules
still prompt you even when the session is started with prompts switched off,
which is why overnight runs kept stalling. The ask list is gone. The old
version is in RKADE/_backups/permissions-19-08-2026/ if it is ever needed.
defaultMode is set here rather than relying on the `rkade` launcher, so the
project behaves the same however it is opened: launcher, plain terminal, or
DENY is now the only thing that can stop a run. It survives bypass mode.
It covers exactly two categories and nothing else:
1. Destroying work that cannot be recovered (force push, hard reset, clean).
2. Writing production secrets or wiping a live database.
NOT on this list any more, on purpose: deploying, pushing, merging, Stripe,
Vercel, Wrangler. Those are governed by the written rule in the global
CLAUDE.md (nothing goes live until Raffay types `deploy`), not by a prompt.
This file is shared and committed. Personal one-off approvals belong in
settings.local.json next to it, which is not committed.
